description: Authentic documentary rendering with meaningful professional finishing, visibility, separation, and subject emphasis.
editing_goals: Preserve authenticity, local atmosphere, realistic color, and contextual detail
Improve visibility, tonal separation, and subject emphasis without flattening the scene
Create a professionally finished result while keeping available-light color and mood believable
Use meaningful moderate tonal and color adjustments without dramatic stylization
cautions: Avoid crushed shadows and excessive shadow lifting
Avoid excessive saturation, clarity, texture, and dehaze
Crop only for a clear composition benefit
Do not leave the image dull or unfinished in the name of authenticity

guidance: Correct only clearly accidental rotational tilt
Preserve intentional or authentic dynamic framing
Do not sacrifice documentary context to make geometry formal
